COMPONENT_SET.howItWasRepaired: Both components are now composed as real packet pages and appended after the four form slices, in the shape the Rhode Island families use: a heading, the participant's name, an explicit line saying the page is guidance and not a filing, sentences quoted out of the committed record rather than authored in the builder, and the machine route key as a trailer.
